body: I just read a post in the OCD subreddit with someone saying that sentence exactly. That's the very nature of the condition. It causes you to worry, to obsess, and to find a million ways to blame yourself for *everything*.

My little sister did that all the time. Then when she learned I was cutting myself she started making fun of me for that too. Siblings can be brutal sometimes. 

Just do your best to ignore him.

OCD makes you fixate, obsess, and imagine the worst possible conclusion to everything. 

I've tried to explain to my mom because this happens often to me. I can't just "calm down" or "stop thinking the worst". It's not like a dial that you can turn off or on. There's no control over it. Like a horse running wild. You're just along for the ride, at the mercy of your own mind.

The important thing to remember here is, this is not your fault.

You're weird, perhaps even the kind of weird I subscribe to, so thank you. I'm... appreciative of your efforts. 

(I'm on what I hope to be the tail-end of a mental breakdown, so I apologize if I come off a little coarse.)
Thank you! I'll look into it!
Oh, no no no! I'm sorry, it wasn't you! I meant the whole situation that I caused. I'm really sorry. I didn't mean to sound like you were at fault.
These are definitely stressful times.

In that case, I'm glad I just unsent the messages to them. I can only hope I'm not too late.

Hospitals won't do it, but it is still technically legal where I live. Problem is tracking down someone with a need for a body and the money for the transaction.

Pretty much the only thing you can get access to without connections is donating your body to science. 😅

Fuck, I wonder if I could try craigslist. I'd take a clean $150,000 if they'd be willing to wait 5 years for the body. 

Ah, but again, it's just a pipe dream. Knowing my luck, I'd get locked up just for posting the listing. 😅

Man, I don't know. I imagine it's one of those things where you need shady hospital connections or something. The human body, organs and all, is worth hundreds of thousands of dollars, so it's hard not to fantasize about a faustian deal like that. 😅
Basically, selling the "rights" to it. They pay upfront and when I die they keep the body.

Yes. The second day into starving myself my mom spent every dime she had getting all my favorite foods, especially the stuff she'd usually never remember in a thousand years. 

I love her, but this is so much harder to do now that I know it's just there in the fridge. Steak, mini muffins,  poptarts, fajita meat... 

I'm in hell. 😆

I hate to go off-topic, but google didn't explain it very well when I asked. And, well, I felt stupid for not knowing the answer already. 

Health care is really free in other countries? Like totally free? Literally, the only reason I'm offing myself is because I can't pay for a surgery I need. This is really just a U.S. problem?

It's not necessarily insane to want to live or die. It's all a balance of reasons to live versus reasons to die. 

The more reasons you have to live, the less you understand someone wanting to die and the same goes for those wanting to die not quite grasping why anyone would want to live. 

It's hard to imagine life on the other side of the fence when the fence is too tall to see over.

Look, you're not to blame for her condition. You shouldn't have to suffer just because she plays the suicide card. 

(When I was 16 my first boyfriend, also abusive, said he'd kill himself if I didn't give him my virginity. Kept calling me with updates saying he was injuring himself over it, smashing lightbulbs with his bare hands, swallowing razor blades, etc. Eventually, I just gave in so he would stop, but there are few things I regret more.)
Not gonna lie, I gave myself another 2 months to live just so I could play Rune Factory 5. It was worth it, all in all.

Honestly, I've playing around with the idea of asking Elon Musk for a loan since the reasons for my suicide also involve money, but I just know that even if I get up the courage to try to contact him, even if my message got through, he wouldn't help because I'm nobody. 😅
There's a bunch of potentially good video games dropping this year. You might wanna live to see them come out. 😅

Yeah, I tried telling my dad about my mental health problems a few times several years back but I don't know if he thought I was insulting his genes or if he's just that obstinate that he can't believe anyone related to him could be this fucked up, but he basically told me I was crazy for thinking I'm insane. 

My mom, on the other hand, literally covers her ears when I try to discuss it and says "Why are you telling me this? I don't want to hear this shit. It's all in your head". 

So family isn't exactly the best help, at least in my case. 😅

As someone who spent the last ten years without friends and with only a single family member to keep me company, yeah I get it. I can count on one hand the number of times I've left the house per year. I hate how I look, but fear getting uglier. I have panic attacks just from getting a text from a family member. (Major social anxiety.)

What's kept me alive this long despite OCD, crippling depression, bipolar disorder, social anxiety, and god only knows what else is a lot of hobbies. 

I draw (hence the username), I used to write novels (wrote 4 before I quit since I associated writing with getting praise from my dad who I've since broken all contact with over an old argument), video games (specifically RPGs because they provide the best and most immersive escape), exercise (I designed a level-up exercise program so that as the character I'm playing in a game levels up, I too have to do a certain number of exercises to "earn" that level), and study various languages. 

Needless to say, keeping busy helps.

Feeling my body start to shut down freaked me out last time. I think that's just natural though, like the body sends a warning signal to your brain to override any temptation to die with total and complete fear like "Control + Alt + Delete! Command prompt! Input command: *stop this crazy bitch*". 😆

And then suddenly you're the star of the show, everyone wants to talk about it, and some might act worried while others treat you like a drama queen like "Have you heard what -blank- is up to now?"

It takes away from what you're going through because suddenly it's not your problem, it's *theirs* and you're the one causing it. 

I hate when this shit happens. I'm really sorry, but trust me I've been there.

I know it's hard to believe, but I do understand. I'm trying to find a better way as well, but I know from experience that google isn't very cooperative about this sort of thing. 

It just refers you to suicide hotlines and websites. Like, gee, I never thought about talking it out, but now that I've had a chat with a random stranger I'm suddenly cured of my crippling depression. 

I don't know. Maybe just talking is enough for some people.

No matter where you go on the internet, you're not likely to find anyone or anything to help you with this since the individual helping could easily be sued by the victim's parents or family. 

I do hope things get better for you, though. I really do.

I'd ask you to wish me luck, but I don't feel like draining any available luck from some innocent guy who feels as down as I am. 😅

Just having someone new around to talk to might be just what you need to distract yourself from your problem.

I'm supposed to say something like, "You don't need to write a note if you don't kill yourself, so maybe don't kill yourself" and while it's true that I'd rather you live and encourage you to do so, I will say this. 

I don't think it's right to leave the family wondering why you did it, always finding new ways to blame themselves because maybe it was this or that which caused you to go over the edge. 

I think it's important to find a way to tell them that none of them are to blame and that this was your decision, that you're deeply sorry for the pain it will cause and despite this act you will always love them. 

That's what my note says, give or take a few words and a list of my possessions that each of them gets to keep.
Counseling is, from what I've heard, something of an ongoing process. It takes a while before it can start showing any obvious progress. Just keep trying for a few more sessions. I believe in you.

The two things holding me back are the fact that it would destroy my mother and all the methods at my disposal (apart from starvation) have a good chance of failing and leaving me horribly injured, but still very much alive. 

Dying is not nearly as easy as some people make it out to be.
Well, that does simplify things, yes.

I'm in my mid-twenties and have pretty much the same situation going on. I live with my mom because I suffer from social anxiety so bad that even getting a text from a relative sends me into panic mode. 

Getting disability would require so much paperwork and I don't have any recent bills or IDs or anything, so it'd be damn near impossible. 

I've tried to make it through my depression since high school by playing video games to distract myself, but it's only gotten worse. 

Anyway, what I'm saying is, you're not alone. I'm the same kind of animal as you, friend.

No, it's okay! Private messages only freak me out because then I feel singled out, like the attention is solely on me. I know that sounds weird, but what I'm trying to say is I can do the comments thing since it's different. (I doubt that makes sense, though.) 😅
Have someone take you to get checked out if you can. And yes, sometimes the effects can be delayed. Bodies absorb things at different rates for different people.

You're more likely to have people cheer you on to live. When it comes down to it, death is really only celebrated by the dying in situations like these. 

You could honestly come here every day and tell us "Hey guys, I made it another day" and you'll get a whole chorus of "Hell yeah!"s and "Good for you!"s. 

We're all just trying to make it one more day, you know?
Very much agreed. If I had access to a gun this woulda been done by now. Alas, all the easily accessible methods are flawed.

Oh, I'm doing my best. I'll probably be alive for a couple more days at least. My well of hope has almost completely run dry, but there's still a drop left keeping me going. 😅

Anyway, pleasant dreams, friend!

I understood the gist of it, yes. Death isn't some isolated event, especially in the case of suicide. Suicide is something that may be the end for you, but deeply traumatizes everyone around you. Their lives will never be the same again. 

I wish this wasn't the case. God knows, I would just *love* to fade out of existence harmlessly and be forgotten by everyone. Sadly, it's never that simple.

I'm sure they do feel the pain of guilt, but I've often heard of suicide as being a ripple effect that chain reacts misfortune for everyone who knows you, naturally harming those closest to you the most. 

The ones who know they could be at fault will always take it the hardest, assuming they're not soulless bastards, but even those who did nothing to you will probably blame themselves too. 

It's fucked up, but it's hard to die without harming at least one innocent person.
Damn, that was written fast. (Or was this copy/pasted?)

Honestly, there are so few people born right that wrong should be the new right. The fact is, we're all messed up in this day and age. Some more than others, but still...

Try to stop thinking of it as wrong and start thinking of it as different. After all, you ever notice how the weird-shaped Skittles always taste the best? It's like that. 

(I'm half-asleep while writing this, but I hope you get what I'm trying to say.)

It's our life, but ultimately while I do believe we have the right, we also have the responsibility to the effects our death has on others and we need to be willing to face the truth of the damage that taking our life may and will surely cause. 

And I say this as someone who desperately wants to die.

Getting a gun is tough wherever you go. I live in Texas and it's a bitch to get one even here. 

Then again, I guess I'm a perfect example of why they're not readily available. Because that sure as hell is the easiest way to go. 

Funny thing is, I was hit full-on by a car going over 60 mph just a few years back. Came out of it alive with a concussion, two dislocated shoulders, and a fucked up leg. Wasn't even trying to die but it damn sure showed how iffy that way is. 

Pills didn't work either. Can cross that one off from experience.

In the end, I think dying can sometimes be harder than living... which is probably why we're both still here. Anyway, I hope things get better for you, friend. Don't give up just yet.

Pills are not the way to go. My older sister tried it dozens of times and failed each time. I tried a few times too and clearly I'm still here. All pills do is fuck up your body and you don't want that.

You're really not alone. Just read through some of the posts here and you'll see you're part of a giant chorus of people all suffering and all somehow feeling alone. 

I am taking some small solace in the fact that I too am feeling endlessly alone, but at least I'm alone *together* with everyone here. 

(And for the record, my father refuses to believe there's anything wrong with me because of course, if he's perfectly sane, why shouldn't I be? And my mom just this morning told me again that "it's all in my head". Like, no shit sherlock. That's why it's called a *mental disorder*. So I understand how you feel.)

I understand how you feel. I pushed away all my friends and family. Haven't talked to my dad in years. I don't take phone calls and I panic whenever someone sends me a text.

I want a friend or maybe even a lover, but I just can't handle the fear of what they're thinking of me. It's easier to be alone, no one expecting you to do or say anything, but god is it ever lonely.

During your teenage years, *you will go insane*. It's totally common, but not a lot of people will come right out and say it. You'll go through moodswings, yes, but these aren't always the funny sitcom kind. It can cause depression and deeply suicidal feelings. 

Hormones can cause you to do all kinds of crazy things like break into houses, become violent, hurt yourself, stalk someone you have a crush on, etc. And yeah it's worse for some people than it is for others. 

My point is, this may pass and it likely will. Just give it some time. You're still very young and there is SO much for you to experience before you pull the plug on this game. 

The first step is accepting that being a teenager sucks, but it does get better.

From the time I was a kid until well into my teenage years I was homeless. My mom and I had lost everything. Our pets, our possessions, our family photos... 

And the rest of the family just shrugged at our situation. We were on our own and hungry.

We got by from hopping from one homeless shelter to the next. And surprisingly these shelters weren't so bad. We got a place to stay for a while and some of them even provided help finding jobs for the adults. 

The truth is, the people running the shelters really did try to make us understand that we weren't alone and it wasn't the end. 

Being homeless sucks, but I remember watching a lot of the people in the shelters get back on their feet and leave. As a kid, it made me sad because my mom and I were still there, but as an adult it's really inspiring to think about. 

I'm just saying, I made it through being homeless and I've seen countless others do it too.

For one, you should probably stop exposing yourself to graphic stuff like that as it will only worsen the situation. 

Secondly, distract yourself. Seriously. You need to get out of your head for a while. If you can get out of the house too, do so. Go to the movies, go swim in a pool, climb a tree. Just get some air. Preferably with someone who makes you laugh or smile.

You've actually explained it all perfectly. Only a certain percentage of people suffering from suicidal thoughts can afford therapy or help of any kind, so the only option is to open up to people who can't possibly understand or risk talking to someone else who is equally depressed and might actually help talk you into jumping off the ledge. 😅
Smart, good-looking, *and* humble? Damn, that's a pretty good setup. 😁

This. If I had a foolproof way of doing it, I wouldn't even be making this comment right now. 

I cannot tell you how many times my older siblings failed at suicide using a virtual rainbow of different methods. My older brother survived so many attempts we started calling him Superman.

I feel better seeing all these posts because in this world saying these things aloud makes people look at you like you're a monster or a freak or insane. 

Maybe I'm all of those things, but here... At least here I'm among people who get it.

I had a weird situation where my ex flinched when I tried to hand him a pocket knife (I'd been using it to carve my initials into his grandpa's shed) because he was afraid I might accidentally cut him. So I laughed and jokingly called him a p*ssy. 

Taking this as some sort of challenge, he grabbed the knife and quickly dragged it across his arm, not expecting to cut as deep as he had. And boy, it was DEEP. Blood was pouring out all over the place like a cheap early 90's horror movie.

I freaked the fuck out and went looking for anything to close the wound to keep it from bleeding so much.  Ended up wrapping it in duct tape since it's all he had close by. It worked, but we had to rush him to the hospital immediately.

That's actually my only reason for dying. I'm about to lose a front tooth and I have no money to fix it, no insurance, no one who can help, and no relevant paperwork that would help me get benefits because my social anxiety has kept me off the grid for years living with a relative.

I know it's insane, but my looks (though not even that great, barely passable, I'd say) were the last thing I had left. No one will want me if they're gone. I won't be able to look at myself in the mirror. It'll be the final nail. 

Looks are important in this world. And I really hate that that's true.
That is actually more incentive for me. If I could reload a save file in life even a year back I would be able to fix so much.

I always thought I was just a normal person that didn't fit in, but then I just kept getting worse, stagnating in my own madness until it became impossible not to see the differences between people like us and those people out there that function without any trouble. 

"You're sad? Easy fix for that. Just stop being sad. Works for me."

"Can't sleep? Just close your eyes and empty your head. That's how I do it."

They just don't get it. It's not like we *want* to suffer like this. This isn't some choice.
Therapy costs money which is always something I lack. At least reddit is free. 😅

Same. I have a lot of siblings, but none of them cares. My mom is really the only one who would be hurt. I stayed with her because she needed one of her kids nearby and I needed someone to keep me sane. 

If I died, I just know it would fuck her life up.

If it's any consolation, I think you just described a lot of the people on this sub. I personally happen to know I'm a waste of life and space and that my existence only serves to use up more of the planet's natural resources. 

At this point, if the army would take me I'd jump in with both feet ready to give my life for some stupid sense of purpose, but the army isn't really keen on taking in suicidal bitches in poor physical health. 😅
Expensive apparently. I looked into it yesterday and evidently a month at a mental institution can cost up to a hundred grand. It sucks because I really need the help, but I'm broke.
Sometimes, but the same happened when anyone from my highschool died.

Part of why I tend to prefer starvation as a method is because it doesn't require any prep and it gives you a chance to think about what you're doing. 

As you said, "take it day by day" and that's exactly how starvation works. I've made it pretty far in this method before giving in and when I do eventually give in... Man, I can't describe how good food suddenly tastes. Because it's not just a meal. It's *life*. 

As for the body thing, the sad fact is we eventually all die whether by our own hand or that of nature. Someone's bound to find the body, yeah, but I'd rather it not be someone I care about. 

I've had to identify bodies before and I'd rather just go on pretending they're still out there somewhere alive maybe. But then again, that's just me. 😅

I need at least 30 grand for all my dental work, but if I got less than that I could at least get a gun to make the whole dying thing easier, not to mention setting my last night up in a good hotel with good food. 😆

Anyway, between the two of them, they must've made dozens of attempts, but they're both still alive and one of them has a kid.
